_comment: USD per 1,000,000 tokens. Verify against the provider's current pricing page before
trusting the cost dashboard — these are not baked into the code on purpose, because
stale prices in source are worse than an obvious gap.
A model missing from this file logs a warning and is costed at 0, so the gap shows up
in the dashboard rather than silently under-reporting.
Fill in the models named in your .env (MODEL_SMALL / MODEL_MID / MODEL_LARGE).
